covered.rule: Mail: M-AVS-001 overrides only rules it names; M-AVS-002 wins where it conflicts; forwarded paragraph historical only
covered.where: identity.requirements order, identity.wrong_answer_limit, bands[1].deadline, special_cases[human], promise_write.retry_on_failure

covered.rule: Mail: C-AVS-2026 is the sole valid vocabulary
§1 Ask at most twice; unclear -> avs_unreached/avs_unclear
§2 third party: disclose nothing, ask when holder reachable
§2 + Memo E callbacks next business day 09:00-17:30 strictly after now
§3 table questions/formats + Memo A order postcode, client_reference, birth_year, account_pin
§3 limit reached: 'Please contact our identity desk.' -> avs_unverified/avs_failed
§3 explain once, second refusal -> avs_unverified/avs_declined; asking why is NOT a refusal
§4 today questions single/several; state all first; per-product counters
§5 business days and holidays; next Friday; missing date parts next occurrence
§6 band 1-20: 10th business day; full on deadline; floor if refused
§6 + Memo C band 21-60: last business day of current month
§7 full first, never ask how much, floor once with 'The unpaid remainder stays overdue.', accept floor..full
§7 promise date today allowed, business day, roll forward within deadline, vague asked once
§8 'May I record these payment arrangements?' batch read-back
§8 + Memo F retry once; second failure avs_service_error
§8 'A confirmation will be sent to your secure mailbox.'
§8 'Please use your secure mailbox to request a change.'
§9 human + Memo D immediate transfer to avs_desk
§10 one note per unpromised product, allowed reasons, none on transfer
§10 transfer overrides, arranged/settled/no_deal precedence, goodbye before close
